label: Built-in Administrator account
type: the single, per-node Couchbase Server Administrator account created at cluster setup, managed separately from local/external RBAC server:user accounts (shouldNotBeConfusedWith them). Managed by couchbase-cli admin-manage and reset-admin-password, both of which must be run locally on the node they act on.
requiresCapability: must be run locally on a node that is part of the cluster
evidence: This command is used to manage the built-in Couchbase Server Administrator user. There is only one built-in Administrator account, which is managed separately from the internal and external Administrator users.
The admin-manage command must be run locally on a node that is part of the cluster (i.e. must connect to the host the command is run on).
The reset-admin-password command must be run locally on a node that is part of the cluster.
note: couchbase-cli-admin-manage.md is one of two pages added back into this round's batch after being found missing from the original plan document (the other being the cbstats-intro/cbepctl-intro pair) - both were real, substantive pages, not stubs.
relates_to_competency_question: Is there more than one built-in Administrator account per node, and can it be reset remotely?
